gnosh prompt tools

  Print what the model is told about each tool, with sizes.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt tools [flags]

Flags
  --json
      Print the exact objects the model is sent. (Not built yet.)
  --export
      Write each tool's description to a file you can edit, with a list for
      turning tools off. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
